whyItMatters: apex server fetches assemble URLs from parts (req.setEndpoint('https://api.corp.invalid/' + p…), so untrusted input reaches internal hosts.
actions: Restrict fetch hosts with a Named Credential endpoint, blocking metadata, localhost, and private ranges.
Block file/gopher/dict schemes and re-validate redirect targets.
Re-run the scan and confirm no open fetch remains.
verification: Rescan shows no open fetch, and metadata/internal probes are refused.
